verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe retrieved an unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.0.3 file at /openapi/mesh-api.json covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at guessed well-known paths do not contradict this, because the spec exists at a documented different path. Missing for 10: no confirmation that the spec covers the full API surface (e.g., webhooks, batch processing), no standard discovery path (e.g., /openapi.json or a link from llms.txt).
